faqs.q: If I hold a short-term rental permit, what are my obligations to maintain the permit?
faqs.a: You are required to renew your permit prior to the expiration date. If the property is no longer rented prior to your renewal, you are required to notify the Community and Economic Development Department to inform us that you are abandoning your permit. All listings must be removed from all marketplace facilitators.
